title: The Birthday Peanut-Butter Pad
subtitle: Henry helps Leo through the party bustle to share a birthday treat.

levels.title: Birthday Morning
levels.clue: It's the brothers' birthday! Leo is already sniffing around the kitchen.

levels.title: Party Prep Dust
levels.clue: Mom tidies up for the party. Clear the dust so Leo has a calm spot.

levels.title: Wrapping-Paper Rustle
levels.clue: Gift bags crinkle and cans clink. Henry quiets them one at a time.

levels.title: Pads on the Counter
levels.clue: The peanut-butter pads are up high. Clear beneath them so they slide down to Mom.

levels.title: Leo Hides from the Hubbub
levels.clue: Too much party! Leo slipped away. Henry follows his pawsteps to him.

levels.title: Too Much Commotion
levels.clue: Quiet the clattery noisemakers and gather happy Leos for the party.

levels.title: The Hidden Treat
levels.clue: Mom hid a surprise. Henry follows familiar clues while Leo stays close.

levels.title: Spilled Water Bowl
levels.clue: Someone bumped the water bowl! Keep Leo dry and gather snack-time Leos.

levels.title: Two Pads, Two Brothers
levels.clue: Bring both pads down and spread the party blanket wide enough for two.

levels.title: The Peanut-Butter Pad
levels.clue: One last birthday wish: bring the pads to Mom and make a cozy spot to share them.
